versions.changelog:
- Improved documentation for easier installation and setup, including clearer instructions for placing custom Hatsune Miku GIFs.
- Added instructions for using a new install-deps.sh script to automate dependency installation.
- Clarified and simplified the one-click acceleration (清理加速) feature and GIF image selection logic.
- Updated systemd auto-start and troubleshooting sections for better clarity.
- Minor adjustments to feature descriptions and usage steps for improved user experience.

Initial release of Hatsune Miku Monitor.

- Cute desktop system monitor with animated Miku GIF
- Real-time display of CPU, memory, disk usage, temperature, and FPS
- Interactive features: panel toggle, drag to move, edge auto-hide, adjustable transparency
- One-click system acceleration and cleaning (optional enhanced effect with proper setup)
- Supports custom images for personalization
- Linux systemd autostart and common troubleshooting steps provided
